objects.name: Analytic 2132
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies execution of network discovery tools on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset by a User Identifier (UID) that does not normally perform network scanning. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
